definitions.explanation: A magazine or periodical that is published once a month.

examples.japanese: この{月刊誌|げっかんし}を{毎月|まいつき}{読|よ}んでいる。
examples.english: I read this monthly magazine every month.

examples.japanese: {月刊誌|げっかんし}の{最新号|さいしんごう}が{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: The latest issue of the monthly magazine arrived.

examples.japanese: {趣味|しゅみ}の{月刊誌|げっかんし}を{定期購読|ていきこうどく}している。
examples.english: I have a subscription to a hobby monthly magazine.

notes:
{月刊誌|げっかんし} refers to a magazine published once a month. The word combines {月刊|げっかん} (monthly publication) with {誌|し} (magazine).

FORMS:
{月|げつ} (month) + {刊|かん} (publication) + {誌|し} (magazine)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月刊誌|げっかんし}を{読|よ}む: to read a monthly magazine
- {月刊誌|げっかんし}を{定期購読|ていきこうどく}する: to subscribe to a monthly magazine
- {月刊誌|げっかんし}の{最新号|さいしんごう}: the latest issue of a monthly magazine

PUBLICATION FREQUENCY TERMS:
- {週刊誌|しゅうかんし}: weekly magazine
- {隔週刊|かくしゅうかん}: biweekly
- {月刊誌|げっかんし}: monthly magazine
- {季刊誌|きかんし}: quarterly magazine
- {年刊|ねんかん}: annual publication
